# Fabrial

> Sovereign AI agent security fabric and dynamic multi-tier router coordinating kernel sandboxing, hardware microVMs, and biometric credential injection.

## Core Capabilities
- Dynamic Multi-Tier Command Routing: Evaluates commands via AST heuristics and `fabrial.yaml`, dispatching to Tier 1 (Airlock kernel sandbox, <15ms) or Tier 2 (Aegisbox microVM, ~100ms hardware boundary).
- Ambient Session Broker: Zero-hop environment injection for frictionless agent routing.
- Circuit Breaker Tripwire Bus: Listens on `~/.argus/argus.sock`; triggers process SIGKILL and dispatches credential revocation to Locksmith and Conjoiner on policy breach.
- Health Probes: `fabrial doctor` validates kernel sandbox hooks, microVM sockets, and daemon states.

## CLI Usage
- `fabrial run -- <command>`: Executes command under dynamically evaluated security tier.
- `fabrial run --dry-run -- <command>`: Evaluates and displays the routing tier decision without executing.
- `fabrial doctor`: Verifies host security hooks and daemon sockets.
- `fabrial vet`: Lints `fabrial.yaml` configuration.
- `fabrial reset-circuit-breaker`: Clears tripwire lock after security event resolution.

## Key Sockets & Paths
- Configuration: `fabrial.yaml`
- Control Socket: `~/.fabrial/fabrial.sock`
- Dependency Sockets: `~/.argus/argus.sock`, `~/.locksmith/locksmith.sock`, `~/.conjoiner/conjoiner.sock`, `~/.aegisbox/aegisboxd.sock`
- Parent Runbook: `docs/knowledge-base/01-fabrial.md` in repository `spanreed`
